findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no acl set to private and no public access block configured, allowing unauthenticated access to potentially sensitive customer data stored within it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects are stored unencrypted at rest, risking exposure of sensitive data.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer records to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored data unencrypted and vulnerable if access controls are bypassed.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so operational data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data science datasets are stored unencrypted at rest.
